claim: Pending principal-part representatives of every actual original source-H1 class, retaining all eight infinity monomials and an element-dependent pole bound.
status: Revision r2 aligns original rational-algebra instances in principal fraction and regular lift; hosted checking, axiom audit and independent acceptance pending.

obligations.name: Actual H1 carrier
obligations.required: The consumer must be the same whole H1 group used by actual quotient pullbacks.
obligations.justification: The boundary imported from ActualSourceHOneCoordinates318 has precisely this codomain; no differential-space equivalence or rationalization is introduced.

obligations.name: Full representative coverage
obligations.required: Every H1 class must have an overlap representative.
obligations.constructed: The argument applies the original boundary_surjective to arbitrary y.
obligations.justification: That surjectivity is the actual full finite/infinity affine cover, transported by the actual overlap section equivalence.

obligations.name: Original chart maps
obligations.required: The maps consumed must be the original finite and infinity inclusions.
obligations.constructed: finite_boundary_zero and infinity_boundary_zero name orderToOpen and toOpen directly.
obligations.justification: Their definitions agree with finiteMap and infinityMap in the original explicit-coordinate presentation.

obligations.name: Boundary signs
obligations.required: The infinity term must vanish with the established finite-minus-infinity convention.
obligations.constructed: The zero-kernel witnesses for infinity b are finite zero and infinity negative b.
obligations.justification: The identity zero - infinityMap(-b) = infinityMap b follows from map_neg; no sign is suppressed.

obligations.name: Whole-ring producer input
obligations.required: The overlap reduction must cover the actual original representative ring.
obligations.constructed: reduction units z is applied to z returned by the original boundary.
obligations.justification: Both abbreviations reduce to ContactKummerOrder318.OpenOrder SourceTwistArithmetic318.units. The inclusion maps are definitionally the same toOpen.

obligations.name: Complete finite index domain
obligations.required: The full infinity monomial basis must be retained.
obligations.constructed: principalClass is indexed by ThreeIndex; the sum is over every element.
obligations.justification: ThreeIndex is exactly the eight-element tensor-product basis domain; no subset is selected.

obligations.name: Polynomial bounds and exceptional case
obligations.required: Each numerator has degree below the actual common pole order, including zero.
obligations.constructed: The n, R and all degree bounds are copied from the whole-ring reduction.
obligations.justification: The WithBot degree statement includes zero polynomials and n=0. No nonzero class or positive pole assumption is required.

obligations.name: Actual class identity
obligations.required: The reduced representative must map exactly to y, with scalar one.
obligations.constructed: The proof applies boundary to the original overlap equality, then map_add and map_sum.
obligations.justification: The actual infinity remainder is killed using infinity_boundary_zero. The remaining summands are literally principalClass by definition.

obligations.name: Unresolved downstream dimension
obligations.required: Elementwise finite representatives must not be reported as a uniform finite basis.
obligations.constructed: The theorem quantifies n after y, with no bound independent of y.
obligations.justification: Finite-chart pole reduction, independence and exact five quotient-pullback identification remain open. Hosted validation and independent acceptance remain pending.
